message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover with a red, orange, and white color palette. Across the top, white text reads "Fatamorgana Ekonomi Hijau H.72" and "Penyelundupan Tenggiling Tiada Henti H.60." Below this, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered above the smaller phrase "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." On the left, bold white text states "EKSPANSI POLITIK DINASTI JOKOWI" followed by a smaller paragraph beginning with "Presiden Joko Widodo memberi jalan..." and ending with "H.22."

The central imagery features four vertically sliced, illustrated human faces aligned horizontally. From left to right, the faces increase in size and age. The leftmost face is complete from forehead to chest, wearing a white shirt and black tie. The next two segments show middle sections of faces, including eyes, noses, and mouths. The final, largest segment on the right shows the right half of an older face. All figures have dark hair and are rendered with warm, painterly textures. The bottom right corner contains a date range "3-9 JULI 2023," a price "RP 50.000," web addresses, an ISSN number, a barcode, and a QR code.
